name: codeshare
description: Share a folder peer-to-peer with another developer's local AI assistant via a remote MCP server.

codeshare.port.description: Port the host MCP server listens on.

enumDescriptions: Publish the session through a Cloudflare quick tunnel. Works across networks and countries with no port-forward or VPN, and gives the guest a real TLS certificate. Requires the `cloudflared` binary on PATH. Note: TLS terminates at Cloudflare's edge, so this path is not end-to-end private.
Serve directly on the configured host/port. End-to-end private, but the guest must reach this machine over LAN, VPN, or a port-forward.
codeshare.tunnel.description: How the host becomes reachable by a guest.

codeshare.maxFileSizeMb.description: Maximum file size (MB) the tools will read/write.

codeshare.host.description: Host address to bind. 0.0.0.0 accepts remote connections; 127.0.0.1 is local-only.

codeshare.cert.description: Optional path to a PEM certificate for the host server. Leave empty to use a generated self-signed cert (LAN/dev) or a plain-HTTP dev server.

codeshare.key.description: Optional path to the PEM private key paired with codeshare.cert.
